usedFor: Presenton builds slide decks, and “Create presentation” generates one from your content and chosen settings.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in Google Meet, then “Create presentation” in Presenton
bestTemplate.why: The action generates a polished deck from the content you pass in, so a first deck exists straight away.

watchOut: “Create presentation” makes a new deck on each run, so run it once per deck you need.
